source_name: National Institute for Strategic Studies (NISS) analyses of IFI project implementation and financial inclusion (uk)
why_relevant: Ukrainian state think-tank commentary on how IFI investment projects are actually implemented and on financial-inclusion policy directions; reveals bottlenecks and named programmes that IFI press releases smooth over.

source_name: Radnuk / Konsaltua — public procurement practitioner press
why_relevant: Practitioner journals explaining procurement rules, payment/delivery clause drafting and weekly ДАСУ monitoring digests, with named-buyer authorship (including the NBU). Useful for interpreting contract terms and for spotting recurring buyers and disputes to follow up.

B2B portal explicitly aimed at bankers, publishing banking analytics and statistics on the Ukrainian and international market including card products and channel research. Historically a rare source of comparative product/channel studies. Note: site is http and its update cadence should be checked — possible partially dormant archive, which still has value as a historical baseline.

source_name: Stakeholder.com.ua — Ukrainian banks statistics and analytics section
why_relevant: Commercial analytics/media hybrid publishing bank asset, reporting and ranking material; a low-cost secondary aggregator useful for spotting which figures circulate publicly and for snowballing to the underlying agency reports.

Ukrainian-language finance portal with news, advice and analytics on banks and personal finance; low institutional weight but occasionally surfaces retail-level card/cash behaviour framing. Monitor at low frequency.

source_name: Ощадбанк — блог про безготівкові розрахунки (bank-published consumer education with mix data)
why_relevant: State bank content citing cash-share benchmarks for Ukraine versus peers; Oschadbank has the widest rural branch and cash footprint, so its commentary and network data are a useful indirect read on residual cash demand outside cities.

Public CVs of Ukrainian card/EMV/ATM specialists describe employer projects in detail — e.g. legacy CMS to Way4 migrations, Digital Payments Hub architecture, EMV/POS certification work — naming systems and timelines that no company announced. Extremely high signal, but personal data.

Supplier-side association (founded 2010 after the Okey Ukraine chain collapse) representing producers and distributors selling into grocery chains. Its subject matter is payment terms, receivables and chain solvency — an indirect but direct-to-the-point view of B2B payment behaviour in retail supply chains.

source_name: 112.ua English edition — payment market structure reporting
why_relevant: Carries structural counts of Ukraine's payment market (payment systems, money-transfer systems, technology operators) in English — useful for participant-landscape mapping.

source_name: EU4Business initiative — Ukraine country reports and guarantee facility data
why_relevant: EU/EIF-backed SME finance programme reporting for Ukraine; country reports quantify credit flows through partner banks and digitalisation support, providing donor-side context for merchant/POS acceptance growth.

Corporate content hub publishing uk-language merchant-side explainers on acquiring and payment acceptance; reveals how POS acceptance is marketed to Ukrainian SMEs and occasionally cites market sizing.

Mass-audience outlet that has run 'картки vs кеш' pieces on why Ukrainians are reluctant to abandon cash, typically citing association/bank research. Weak as evidence, useful for tracking public narrative on cash usage.

source_name: PayAtlas Ukraine country profile (PSP / method landscape)
why_relevant: Merchant-facing country guide enumerating Ukrainian PSPs, local payment methods and compliance/fee context. Useful as a cross-check actor list in English and for identifying which local methods international merchants actually integrate.

Data-explainer site that converts Ukrainian payment-infrastructure statistics into short quantified notes (e.g. +19% growth in card-accepting points in 2025). Low institutional weight but useful for surfacing series and framing; must be traced to primary.

source_name: Ukrainian Marketing Group (Українська Маркетингова Група, UMG)
why_relevant: Established Ukrainian full-service research agency; relevant as a commissioned-research supplier to banks and payment companies, and its published case/portfolio pages indirectly reveal which financial institutions buy consumer research and on what questions.

source_name: Yavir-2000 (Явір-2000) — ATM security and component supplier
why_relevant: Ukrainian supplier of ATM protection systems and ATM components to banks. Wartime ATM physical-security spend is a distinctive Ukrainian market segment; this vendor's pages evidence demand and name the bank-security requirements driving fleet refresh.

Association of Ukrainian non-bank financial companies (USREOU 40337251) — the segment that now holds NBU payment-institution and e-money licences. Its positions on non-bank payment regulation are not covered by the bank associations, so it fills a real gap even though its publishing footprint is thin.
